result.description:
Stores Person Needed in Geebung, Brisbane!   Your new company     HAYS has partnered with one of Australia's leading industrial-equipment manufacturers within the mining sector who specialises in the drilling industry. They are known for their industry expertise and being able to deliver advanced performance and products. Our client is currently seeking a store person to join their Northgate team to keep their daily operations running smoothly.    Your new role     
 As a Store Person, you will play an important role within the logistics team and have the following duties and responsibilities, but not limited to: 
   
 
 Manage the receivables of parts from external suppliers 
 Assist in the picking and packing of orders and have them ready for dispatch from the facility. 
 Operate counterbalance forklift when required 
 Take part in data entry for inventory control and basic computer entry 
 Liaise deliveries to customers and external partners 
 Assist in stock counts when required 
 Responsible for receipting duties 
 Carry out dispatch duties such as booking shipments via phone, online, labelling, dispatch notes & invoices when required. 
 Manage warehousing consumables and replenishing when needed. 
 General maintenance and housekeeping of the warehouse 
 Pre-checks of the forklifts and attend toolbox meetings 
 Follow safety procedures and protocols   
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be a successful candidate for our client, you must hold the following: 
   
 
 High Risk Work - LF Forklift Licence 
 Previous experience in warehousing or store person role 
 Experience with SAP Systems HANA is highly desirable. 
 Current Queensland Driver's Licence - Manual Licence highly desirable 
 Previous experience with inventory management 
 Great communication skills and able to collaborate with departments 
 Confident in liaising with customers and external partners 
 Ability to work independently 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 For your ongoing commitment to this role you will: 
   
 
 Receive PPE upon commencement of the role 
 3 days a week to then be moved to 5 days a week 
 9.5-hour working days 
 Opportunity for a permanent placement based on performance 
 Be part of an industry-leading business in the mining industry and collaborate with industry experts   
 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're passionate about this role, click 'APPLY NOW' or for more information and a confidential discussion or to find out about other opportunities in Manufacturing or Logistics, contact Taylor Ngata at Hays on 07 3815 0799 or email taylor.ngata@hays.com.au.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
We are a growing Victorian civil construction company specialising in hydro excavation, non-destructive digging, dewatering, drainage, trenching and plant hire services. We are committed to delivering high-quality civil infrastructure solutions while maintaining the highest standards of safety, reliability and customer service. Working across a diverse range of commercial, infrastructure and utility projects, we offer employees the opportunity to be part of a professional, supportive team with a strong focus on quality workmanship, innovation and continuous growth.

We are now seeking a skilled and motivated Drainer’s to join our growing team. Working on a variety of civil construction, drainage, stormwater, and infrastructure projects, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing drainage systems in accordance with project specifications and industry standards.  This is an excellent opportunity to join a professional team that values safety, quality workmanship, and career development while contributing to projects that support sustainable communities and environmental outcomes.

If you have a genuine passion for the industry, have a reliable character, well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to work in a busy environment, work both independently and as a part of a team this is the job for you.  We are offering $90K to $100K

Key Responsibilities
•	Install underground drainage and stormwater systems
•	Read and interpret plans, drawings, and specifications
•	Excavate, lay, and connect drainage pipes and associated infrastructure
•	Conduct testing and inspections of drainage systems
•	Operate and work safely around construction plant and equipment as requirements
•	Ensure all work complies with Australian Standards, project requirements, and WHS regulations
•	Collaborate with supervisors, contractors, and project teams to deliver projects on time and to a high standard
•	Maintain accurate records of work completed and materials used
Experience - Tickets and Licences
•	Demonstrated minimum of 12 months in drainage installation and civil construction projects   
•	White Card
•	Current Driver Licence
•	First Aid
•	Working at Heights
•	Confined Space & Rescue
•	Traffic Management
•	Excavator Licence
Please provide Resume if you are interested. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted
Lodged 2nd July 2026 - Closes 30th July 2026
